prettyUrl.description: Slug suitable for partner display URLs.

instantConfirmation.description:
When `true`, bookings on this product are confirmed immediately without
host approval. `GET /products` only returns products with
`instantConfirmation: true`, so partners will not see un-bookable items.
The field is retained for forward compatibility with a future
request-to-book flow.

languages.description: ISO-639-1 codes the experience can be hosted in.

GuestPrice.description: Per-person price for a specific party size.

guests.description: Party size this per-person price applies to.

retailPrice.description: Per-person price the guest pays, including the service fee.

netPrice.description:
Per-person price the partner pays Withlocals, including the service fee,
with the partner discount applied.

Money.description: A monetary amount in minor units.

amount.description: Integer value in minor units (cents); e.g. `12000` = €120.00.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Always `EUR` in v1.

ProductOption.description: A bookable variant of a product (e.g. a specific start-time slot).

default.description: Whether this is the product's default option.

availabilityLocalStartTimes.description:
Local clock-time slots (`HH:mm`, 24-hour) at which this option starts.
Times are in the experience's own time zone; no date or offset is implied.

pricingPerGuest.description:
Per-person retail and net price per party size
(`minGuests`..`maxGuests`). Party sizes with no configured price are
omitted. Authoritative price source.

Restrictions.description: Booking-size limits for a product option.

minGuests.description: Minimum number of guests per booking.

maxGuests.description: Maximum number of guests per booking.
